sections.text: Introduction

The protection relay type SQT33A is a static transformer differential 
protection. It is used for protection 4 winding 3 phase power transformers.

This procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper 
operation of the relay.

The 
first section is the activities required prior to testing the second section is 
to set up the equipment for performing the actual tests

The 
third section is the actual test. This document is formatted the way to minimize 
the possibility of error causing personal injury or damage equipment
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass...etc.
Line isolation is required

Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the relay current 
 circuits for current injection

sections.text: Testing Procedure(s)
Current test

Determine the CT terminal 
blocks connected to the relay fro all 3 windings from transformer drawings

Open the internal links of 
the above terminals so the injection will not affect the other relay connected 
to the same core

Connect test leads between 
the current terminals on the relay side related to R and N for first side according to drawings

Slowly increase the 
current until the red indication on differential relay appears. The relay must operate with a current between
 10% of the setting value
Record this value on the test sheet

Increase the injected current with a value 25% 
greater than the operating value
Slowly decrease the current until the relay resets
Record this value on the test sheet

Repeat the above test fro step 3 to 10 but for 
phases S.N then to T.N

Repeat all above steps again for the others two 
windings
